title: Bidirectional annotations
goal:
Build the annotations of Section 3.2. A forward RNN reads $x_1, \ldots, x_{T_x}$ and a backward RNN reads $x_{T_x}, \ldots, x_1$. The annotation is $h_j = [\overrightarrow{h}_j^\top; \overleftarrow{h}_j^\top]^\top$.

The paper uses gated units (Appendix A.2.1). Use a plain tanh cell so the code stays short: $h_t = \tanh(W x_t + U h_{t-1})$, with $h_0 = 0$. The forward and backward RNNs have separate weights.

Write `annotations(X, Wf, Uf, Wb, Ub)`. `X` has shape `(Tx, m)`. Each `W` has shape `(n, m)` and each `U` has shape `(n, n)`. Return an array of shape `(Tx, 2n)` in which row $j$ holds the forward state at $j$ followed by the backward state at $j$.
hints: The forward pass is a loop over `t` from `0` to `Tx - 1` that carries the previous state.
The backward pass is the same loop over `t` from `Tx - 1` down to `0`, with the backward weights.
The backward loop produces its states from the last position to the first. Store each state at index `t`, or reverse the list at the end, so that row $j$ describes position $j$.
Concatenate along the feature axis: forward first, then backward.
